overview.title: Custom ERP Software Development that fits your business
paragraphs: As a business grows, every department picks its own tool. Sales uses Excel, accounts uses Tally, the warehouse keeps a register and production plans on a whiteboard. Data is entered three times, reports take days, and nobody trusts the numbers. An ERP fixes this by making every department work on one shared database.

Insta Biz Web offers two routes. For businesses with standard processes, we implement and customise Odoo ERP, a proven open-source platform with modules for almost every function. For businesses with unique workflows, we build a fully custom ERP from scratch so the software follows your process, not the other way around.

Either way, you get GST-ready invoicing, multi-location inventory, purchase and production planning, role-based access and dashboards that show profitability, stock and cash flow in real time. We handle data migration, training and ongoing support, so your ERP keeps pace as your business grows.

faq.title: Custom ERP Software software: your questions answered

items.q: What is ERP software?
items.a: ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) software connects all core business functions such as sales, purchase, inventory, production, accounting and HR into one system with a shared database, so information flows automatically between departments.

items.q: Should we choose Odoo or a fully custom ERP?
items.a: Odoo is ideal when your processes are close to standard and you want a faster, cost-effective rollout. A fully custom ERP is better when you have unique workflows that off-the-shelf software cannot handle. We recommend the right route after a free discovery session.

items.q: How long does ERP implementation take?
items.a: A typical SME implementation takes 2 to 4 months, depending on modules, data migration and customisation. We go live in phases so critical modules start delivering value early.

items.q: Is the ERP GST compliant?
items.a: Yes. We configure GST invoicing, HSN/SAC codes, e-invoice and e-way bill generation and GST return reports as per Indian regulations.

items.q: Can we migrate our data from Tally and Excel?
items.a: Yes. We migrate masters and opening balances such as customers, vendors, products, stock and ledgers from Tally, Excel or your existing software.

items.q: Is the ERP cloud-based or on-premise?
items.a: Both options are available. Most clients choose secure cloud hosting for anywhere access, but we also deploy on your own servers when required.

paragraphs: HR teams in growing companies spend the last week of every month compiling attendance from biometric devices, reconciling leave, calculating overtime and building payroll in Excel. One wrong formula leads to incorrect salaries, compliance issues and unhappy employees.

Our HRMS and payroll software automates this cycle. Attendance flows in from biometric devices or the mobile app with GPS, leave and shifts are applied automatically, and payroll is processed with PF, ESI, professional tax and TDS calculated correctly. Payslips are generated and shared in a click.

Employees get a self-service app to mark attendance, apply for leave, claim expenses and download payslips, which cuts HR queries dramatically. Management gets reports on headcount, attrition, attendance trends and salary costs across departments and locations.

overview.title: Inventory & Distribution Management Software that fits your business
paragraphs: For traders, wholesalers and distributors, inventory is cash. Too much stock blocks working capital, too little loses sales, and stock that does not match the books leads to losses nobody can explain. Most of these problems start with manual stock registers and disconnected billing software.

Our inventory and distribution software tracks stock in real time across warehouses, godowns and vans, with barcode and batch or serial tracking where you need it. Reorder levels and demand trends tell you what to buy and when, and every inward and outward movement is recorded with a clear audit trail.

On the sales side, salesmen book orders on a mobile app with live stock and scheme details, deliveries are planned and tracked, and GST invoices with e-way bills are generated automatically. Outstanding payments by retailer are visible to salesmen in the field, helping you collect faster.

faq.title: Inventory & Distribution software: your questions answered

items.q: What is inventory management software?
items.a: Inventory management software tracks stock levels, movements and valuation across locations in real time, helping businesses avoid stock-outs, reduce excess inventory and prevent losses.

items.q: Does it support multiple warehouses?
items.a: Yes. You can manage stock across any number of warehouses, godowns, shops and delivery vans with inter-location transfers.

items.q: Can salesmen book orders from a mobile app?
items.a: Yes. Salesmen get an app to book orders with live stock, schemes and retailer outstanding, even in low-network areas.

items.q: Does it generate GST invoices and e-way bills?
items.a: Yes. The system creates GST-compliant invoices, e-invoices and e-way bills directly from sales orders.

items.q: Can it integrate with Tally?
items.a: Yes. Sales, purchases and receipts can sync with Tally so your accountant continues working in familiar software.

items.q: Does it support barcode and batch tracking?
items.a: Yes. We support barcode printing and scanning, batch and expiry tracking and serial numbers based on your products.
